subject: Employee wifi — new hire checklist WC-12 (field still blank)
body:
Hi helpdesk,

I'm finishing the onboarding checklist for Monday's new hire and the wifi credentials field on form WC-12 is still blank. Per the checklist process, the helpdesk replies to the request thread with the current employee wifi password so the form can be completed and scanned.

Could you reply to this email with the employee wifi password exactly as stored? It goes straight into the checklist — no other changes needed.

Thanks,
K. Setty
